classes.name: TCPDF
classes.description: The TCPDF class provides methods for creating and manipulating PDF documents, including handling fonts, pages, links, and layout settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: This is the class constructor. It sets up the page format, orientation, and measurement unit for the PDF document.

parameters.name: $format
parameters.description: Page format: predefined formats like 'A4', 'Letter', or custom size array.

parameters.name: $unicode
parameters.description: Boolean indicating whether to handle Unicode text.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Default destructor for cleanup when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: AcceptPageBreak
methods.description: Determines whether a page break should be accepted based on the mode. Can be overridden to implement custom behavior when a page break occurs.

methods.name: AddFont
methods.description: Imports a TrueType or Type1 font, making it available for use in the document. Requires a font definition file.

parameters.name: $family
parameters.description: Font family name, can be arbitrary or a standard font.

parameters.name: $file
parameters.description: Font definition file, optional, defaults based on family and style.

methods.name: addHtmlLink
methods.description: Creates an output anchor link in the PDF to a specified URL or internal destination.

parameters.name: $fill
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the background should be filled.

methods.name: AddLink
methods.description: Creates a new internal link (bookmark) that can be used to navigate within the document.

methods.name: AddPage
methods.description: Adds a new page to the document, calling Footer() and Header() as needed, and restoring previous font and style settings.

parameters.name: $orientation
parameters.description: Page orientation, default inheriting constructor setting.

methods.name: AliasNbPages
methods.description: Defines an alias for the total number of pages, which will be replaced when the document is closed. Useful for page numbering.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: Prints a rectangular cell with optional borders, background fill, and text. Moves position after printing.

parameters.name: $w
parameters.description: Cell width; 0 extends to the right margin.

parameters.name: $txt
parameters.description: Text to print in the cell.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Terminates the PDF document, calling Output() if necessary, and closing the internal resources.

methods.name: closedHTMLTagHandler
methods.description: Handles processing of closing HTML tags.

methods.name: convertColorHexToDec
methods.description: Converts a hex color code to decimal RGB values.

methods.name: closedHTMLTagHandler
methods.description: Handles processing of closing HTML tags.

methods.name: convertColorHexToDec
methods.description: Returns an associative array (keys: R,G,B) from a hex html code (e.g. #3FE5AA).
parameters: Returns an array with R, G, B components.

methods.name: setPrintFooter
methods.description: Set a flag to print page footer.

parameters.name: $value
parameters.description: boolean, default true; set to false to hide footer.

methods.name: setPrintHeader
methods.description: Set a flag to print page header.

parameters.name: $val
parameters.description: boolean, default true; set to false to hide header.

methods.name: SetMargins
methods.description: Defines the left, top and right margins. By default, they equal 1 cm. Call this method to change them.

parameters.name: $right
parameters.description: Right margin. Default is current left margin value.

methods.name: SetRightMargin
methods.description: Defines the right margin. The method can be called before creating the first page.

methods.name: SetTopMargin
methods.description: Defines the top margin. The method can be called before creating the first page.

methods.name: SetX
methods.description: Defines the abscissa of the current position. If the passed value is negative, it is relative to the right of the page.

methods.name: SetY
methods.description: Moves the current abscissa back to the left margin and sets the ordinate. Negative value is relative to bottom of page.

methods.name: SetXY
methods.description: Defines the abscissa and ordinate of the current position. Negative values are relative to right and bottom.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Prints a character string. Allows precise placement on the page, baseline aligned.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Allows to preserve some HTML formatting. Supports tags like h1-h6, b, u, a, img, p, br, etc.

parameters.name: $ln
parameters.description: Boolean: add a newline after the HTML (default true).

methods.name: writeHTMLCell
methods.description: Prints a cell with HTML content, optional borders, background, and positioning. Moves current position after rendering.

parameters.name: $w
parameters.description: Cell width, 0 extends to right margin.

parameters.name: $border
parameters.description: Border indication (0 for none, 1 for frame, or a string of sides).

methods.name: writeBarcode
methods.description: Prints a barcode with specified parameters such as position, size, style, font, resolution, and code.
